arguments.value: 70-year-old Sri Lankan man with a 4-year history of exertional dyspnea and recent burning dysesthesia of the distal extremities/scalp, with bilateral renal cortical lesions, elevated ESR, low complement levels, and biopsy findings consistent with IgG4-related disease. Tuberculosis workup was negative, and nerve conduction studies showed mononeuritis multiplex. He was started on oral prednisolone 0.6 mg/kg/day with rapid improvement in respiratory and neurologic symptoms and remains under follow-up.
